notes: The italic *even* is `added`: no waw and no object marker stands between the two participial phrases, so no morpheme licenses it (rules 16, 30, 42).
The construct relation of תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה is recast as *unto* and belongs to the rectum (rule 19), while the predicate noun carries the construction-supplied copula (rule 20).
